t: Support for AS2805 standard.  New API GenerateAs2805KekValidation and changes to translate pin, GenerateMac and VerifyMac to support AS2805 key variants.
Added a new API - translateKeyMaterial; allows keys wrapped by ECDH derived keys to be rewrapped under a static AES keyblock without first importing the key into the service.
Expand length of message data field for Mac generation and validation to 8192 characters.
Additional support for managing HMAC keys that adheres to changes documented in X9.143-2021 and provides better interoperability for key import/export
Add ECDH support on PIN operations.
Adding new API to generate authenticated scripts for EMV pin change use cases.
Added further restrictions on logging of potentially sensitive inputs and outputs.

Adding support for dynamic keys for encrypt, decrypt, re-encrypt and translate pin functions.  With this change, customers can use one-time TR-31 keys directly in dataplane operations without the need to first import them into the service.
AWS Payment Cryptography EMV Decrypt Feature  Release
Make KeyCheckValue field optional when using asymmetric keys as Key Check Values typically only apply to symmetric keys
Initial release of AWS Payment Cryptography DataPlane Plane service for performing cryptographic operations typically used during card payment processing.
